citations.locator: Progressive National Baptist Convention, member profile
citations.excerpt: In 1961, 33 delegates met to envision a new convention that would be progressive and forward-thinking, and respond to the spiritual and social needs of the time.
The seeds of the PNBC were sown at that time by discontent over election procedures in the National Baptist Convention, USA, Inc.

facts.value: A Baptist convention formed in 1961 by delegates seeking a progressive convention. It provided a denominational home for Martin Luther King Jr. and many Baptist leaders in the civil rights movement.

citations.excerpt: It was the PNBC that provided a denominational home for Dr King Jr and many of the Baptist leaders in the Civil Rights Movement.
